title: Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan History and the Rent Increase Limit
content:
**Rule.** The prepaid-plan reduction on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement follows the tenant's Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plans on the agreement: a plan completed within the **36 months** up to the handling date takes **1 percentage point** off the limit percentage, a plan completed earlier takes **half a point** (0.5 points) off, and no completed plan takes nothing off. Points taken off never bring the limit percentage below zero (0 percent), so that a reduction never sets the rent below the rent before the increase.

A plan's completion is read from the Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan record covering this rental agreement: a plan in completed status, and its ended date. A plan completed within the 36 months is one whose ended date lies fewer than 36 whole calendar months before the handling date.

| Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan on the agreement | Points off |
|---|---|
| completed, ended fewer than 36 whole months before the handling date | 1 |
| completed, ended 36 whole months or more before the handling date | 0.5 |
| no completed plan (none, or only an active, cancelled or other plan) | none |

## Hypothetical cases (handling date 1 March 2027)

- A 12-month plan completed on 9 April 2026: 1 point off.
- A plan completed on 28 February 2024, 36 whole months earlier: half a point off.
- A plan still active on the agreement: no completed plan, nothing off.
